previous_admission_summary.summary_paragraph: A 50-year-old woman with primary central nervous system lymphoma, ulcerative colitis, asthma, and a history of DVT/PE was admitted for her 14th cycle of high-dose methotrexate chemotherapy. She tolerated the treatment well with only moderate nausea, managed with anti-emetics. MRI showed stable lymphoma but worsening right-sided sinusitis, prompting a 21-day course of clindamycin. Her chronic right foot pain persisted, managed with gabapentin and PRN oxycodone. She remained emotionally stable on citalopram, with no suicidal ideation. Aspirin was held during admission to enhance methotrexate clearance and was restarted at discharge. She cleared methotrexate without renal or hepatic complications and was discharged home in stable condition with follow-up instructions.

radiology_notes.text:
HISTORY:  ___ woman with CNS lymphoma admitted for chemotherapy. 
Restaging.  

COMPARISON:  MRI brain, ___.

TECHNIQUE:  Multi sequence multi planar imaging of the brain was performed
both prior to and following the intravenous administration of 7 mL Gadavist as
per standard department protocol.  

FINDINGS:

Posttreatment changes in the right frontal lobe with a right frontal and
insular encephalomalacia and old blood products are unchanged to the prior
examination.  There is associated ex vacuo dilatation of the frontal horn of
the right lateral ventricle.  The Reeve associated FLAIR signal hyperintensity
is unchanged.  Craniotomy defect is again noted at the right vertex.  There is
no new lesion and no abnormal enhancement.  

Elsewhere, there are a few scattered foci of FLAIR signal hyperintensity in
the white matter, which is a nonspecific finding.  There is no evidence of
acute infarct or new hemorrhage.  There is no mass effect or shift of normally
midline structures. 

There is mucosal thickening in the left frontal sinus, the ethmoid air cells,
and in the maxillary sinuses with a mucous retention cyst in the right
maxillary sinus.  There is partial opacification of the right mastoid air
cells.  There are neural major intracranial vascular flow voids.  The orbits
are unremarkable.

IMPRESSION:

1.  Stable appearance of right frontal post treatment changes without evidence
of new abnormal enhancement or new lesion. 

2.  Paranasal sinus disease.
